title: Muffin — Universe
description: How much data we hold and how complete it is. From market.universe_sample, which counts every market table (771 ms for all 63, measured) plus every negative cache.

panels.title: Securities
panels.description: A FLOOR matters more than the value: the placeholder-CUSIP bug collapsed thousands of securities into hundreds while every request still returned 200.

targets.rawSql:
select sampled_at as time, metric, value
  from market.universe_sample
 where $__timeFilter(sampled_at)
   and metric in ('rows_estimate.security', 'equities', 'rows_estimate.issuer', 'rows_estimate.fund_holding')
 order by sampled_at

panels.title: Identifier coverage
panels.description: ISIN coverage has measured 98%+. A sharp drop means parsing broke.

targets.rawSql:
select sampled_at as time, metric, value
  from market.universe_sample
 where $__timeFilter(sampled_at) and metric like 'identifiers.%'
 order by sampled_at

panels.title: Negative caches
panels.description: 'We asked and the provider has nothing.' A STEP UP is the shape to fear: on 2026-08-13 an over-eager drain tripped yfinance's rate limit and ~8,300 securities were recorded as permanently unanswerable — INTC, PEP, XOM, REGN — in one afternoon, with every other count staying plausible. Gradual growth is ordinary.

targets.rawSql:
select sampled_at as time,
       replace(metric, 'missing.security.', '') as metric,
       value
  from market.universe_sample
 where $__timeFilter(sampled_at) and metric like 'missing.%'
 order by sampled_at

panels.title: Rows by table (estimated)
panels.description: `pg_class.reltuples`, not count(*). Exact counting every table cost 10.25s cold — a full scan of a 10.9M-row table, 16 times a day, to plot a trend that a few percent of error is invisible on. The numbers market-verify asserts floors on stay exact and are on the panels above.

targets.rawSql:
select sampled_at as time, replace(metric, 'rows_estimate.', '') as metric, value
  from market.universe_sample
 where $__timeFilter(sampled_at) and metric like 'rows_estimate.%' and value > 1000
 order by sampled_at

panels.title: Storage by table
panels.description: Tables over 10 MB. This is the one that says when the nightly pg_dumpall stops being cheap.

targets.rawSql:
select sampled_at as time, replace(metric, 'bytes.', '') as metric, value
  from market.universe_sample
 where $__timeFilter(sampled_at) and metric like 'bytes.%' and value > 10000000
 order by sampled_at

panels.title: Funds tracked and ingested
panels.description: Enabled vs actually ingested. A gap that persists means an N-PORT filing could not be found — and SEC THROTTLING LOOKS LIKE ABSENCE, so check before concluding a fund does not file.

targets.rawSql:
select sampled_at as time, metric, value
  from market.universe_sample
 where $__timeFilter(sampled_at) and metric like 'tracked_funds.%'
 order by sampled_at
